verdict: Ad spend is delivering strong returns; key funnel build items are overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns returned $7,438.90 in revenue on $1,368.38 in spend — a 5.44 return on ad spend that improved another 28% in just the past week, with purchases up 30% week-over-week in the same stretch. That momentum is real and is being protected by holding spend steady while creative and targeting continue to work. At the same time, several foundational build items — including funnel testing, UTM tracking, subscribe pages, automated flows, and your monthly report — are overdue and are being prioritised for completion now. Getting those in place is what unlocks the next phase of scaling, and you should expect visible progress on each before the end of next week.

watch_item.issue: Seven planned build milestones — funnel test, UTM tracking, subscribe pages, automated flows, and the monthly report — are past their due dates, leaving parts of the funnel unmeasured and under-automated.
watch_item.fix: These items are being worked through in order now, with completion targeted before the October 31st review call.
